class Box<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} }
class Missing extends Box {}
new Missing(1);
class Extra extends Box<number, string> {}
new Extra(1);
class Plain { constructor(public value: number) {} }
class NotGeneric extends Plain<number> {}
new NotGeneric(1);
class Label<T extends string> { constructor(public value: T) {} }
class Mismatch extends Label<number> {}
class Calls extends Box { constructor() { super(1); } }
